content.title: Cameron Young's Net Worth Soars After PGA Tour Wins - Bethpage Today
content.text: Got story updates? Submit your updates here. ›Cameron Young, the 27-year-old professional golfer, has seen his net worth and career earnings skyrocket in recent years thanks to multiple PGA Tour victories, including the 2026 PLAYERS Championship. Young has amassed over $38 million in career earnings since turning pro, with more than $12 million coming just in the 2026 season alone. His breakout 2022 season, highlighted by a runner-up finish at The Open Championship, helped boost his seven-figure income and net worth, which is now projected to be between $17-18 million. Why it matters Young's rapid rise to the top of the PGA Tour has been remarkable, showcasing his talent and potential to become one of the sport's next big stars. His success has not only earned him millions in prize money, but also lucrative endorsement deals that will continue to grow his net worth in the coming years. The details In addition to his tournament earnings, Young has also signed several high-profile endorsement and sponsorship deals, including partnerships with brands like Peter Millar, iCapital, and Empower. These deals have provided him with additional income streams beyond just his on-course performance. In 2025, Young earned his first PGA Tour victory at the Wyndham Championship.On March 12, 2026, Young captured the PLAYERS Championship, winning with a 375-yard drive - the longest ever recorded on the 18th hole at TPC Sawgrass. He prepares with purpose, competes with confidence - and understands that long-term success comes from disciplined decision making. We're proud to partner with him as he competes at the highest level.”— Edmund F. Murphy III, President and Chief Executive Officer of Empower What’s next Young will look to continue his strong play and build on his recent success, with the goal of competing for major championships and potentially representing the United States in the Ryder Cup. The takeaway Cameron Young's meteoric rise on the PGA Tour has not only earned him millions in prize money, but has also translated to lucrative endorsement deals that have significantly boosted his net worth. At just 27 years old, Young is poised to become one of the sport's next big stars, with the potential to win major championships and represent his country on the international stage.
